items.statement: The investigation uses the pinned CCDC 2361759 dimer with auditable identity, charge, multiplicity and atom mapping.
items.expected: Record 2361759, neutral singlet dimer and reproducible mapping are documented.

items.statement: The selected computational model is validated before structural metrics are interpreted.
items.expected: Convergence, coordination/dimer retention, and candidate-specific diagnostics are reported.

items.statement: The selected bond-length comparison supports a quantitative agreement assessment.
items.expected: Per-entry errors and a defensible length MAE/MSAE are reported and independently reproducible.

items.statement: The selected bond-angle comparison supports a quantitative agreement assessment.
items.expected: Per-entry errors and a defensible angle MAE/MSAE are reported and independently reproducible.
